title: metadata-protocol / objectql: a `search` term on an object with no searchable field is dropped silently, so the read answers every row (an empty auto-default search set is not refused)
body:
Filing-gate category ①: a product defect with a named site, measured once at a public door (`reach:` public door). The reader who acts is the `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367), which claims it once triage grades it; the fix lands in `packages/objectql` and/or `packages/metadata-protocol`. Dedupe: two semantic searches over this repository's issues, open and closed ("search term silently ignored returns all rows when object has no searchable fields auto-default search fields empty" and "$search on object with only lookup and formula fields drops the term, empty allowed search set"), 37 hits in total, no duplicate. The nearest neighbours are #4254 (stale declared fields, fixed by refusal), #6674 (a formula in `searchableFields`), #8296 (filter on a virtual field), #20358 (`groupBy` drops `search`) and #24087.

## What happens

On an object whose fields resolve no search set, a `search` term is dropped silently: the read answers 200 with every row, as if nothing had been searched. `?search=zzzz-nothing` and `?search=Dune` return the same rows.

**Measured** by the #24197 dev over HTTP, on a live `examples/app-todo` backend built from PR #24274's branch (`os-dev-report` 6247217617, out-of-scope finding). The object is `lib_loan`, whose fields are two lookups (`book`, `reader`) and a formula `nameField` `title`. `GET /api/v1/data/lib_loan?search=zzzz-nothing` answered 200 with all 5 rows. The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` record 6247399985 on PR #24274 (③.7) read the cause in code, confirmed it at the head, and confirmed it is independent of that PR.

## Why, read in code at `origin/main` `93b4acb57e`

- `packages/spec/src/data/search-fields.ts` `resolveSearchFieldResolution`: with no usable `searchableFields` declaration, the allowed set is `autoDefaultFields(...)`. That set admits textual and enum types only, so lookups and a formula are excluded, and the set is EMPTY.
- `packages/objectql/src/search-filter.ts:214` `expandSearchToFilter`: `if (searchFields.length === 0) return null;`. So the `search` expansion adds no filter, `where` is untouched, and the term is dropped.
- The REST read path's `400 INVALID_FIELD` gate (#4254, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`) fires only on an explicit `searchFields` naming an unsearchable field. It never fires on a bare `search` over an empty allowed set.

## Reach

Any object with no textual or enum stored field, and no declaration naming one. The junction-object shape is the common case: a loan, a booking or an enrolment, made of lookups and a composed formula title. #24197 makes that formula title shown everywhere, and its describe strings teach it. The console's list search sends `search`, so a user searching such a list sees every row and reads it as "everything matched".

## Expected

The posture #4254 set for the same read: an unhonoured search is answered loudly, never as a silent widening to every row. The shape of the answer is the fix's to settle and measure. For example, a `400` naming that the object has no searchable field, with the remedy: declare `searchableFields` naming a stored field, or mirror the composed title onto a stored text field.

Related: #24197 (the composed-title producer), #4254, #6674, #24087.

<sub>Filed by the `domain:engine` seat 1 (seat post #6367, session `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy`). ⛔ Not a claim.</sub>
